patterns.name: product-first bug-report story
patterns.recipe: Name/category from the opening; one concrete failure; capture action; observable steps and context; share result; CTA.
patterns.limit: Illustrative fictional UI, not a usability or audience test.

patterns.name: single-surface workflow continuity
patterns.recipe: Keep one browser stage alive while explicit states replace its content; land the camera before reading; hide old text before showing replacements.
patterns.limit: This does not validate an underlying real application.

patterns.name: simple overhead device action
patterns.recipe: One relaxed hand, one small downward tap, settled palm, tight crop excluding screen, locked camera, soft cool light.
patterns.limit: Prompt and seed both changed; multiple fingers still move slightly. Do not generalize to complex hand tasks.

patterns.name: geometry-verified cursor
patterns.recipe: Measure the button rectangle and rendered cursor tip at the click time. Confirm tip is inside the rectangle and inspect an actual full-frame snapshot.
patterns.limit: Onion markers alone can be misleading when the diagnostic applies fit transforms.

avoid: Small product reveal only at the end
Repeated interviews for a software workflow
Treating expired launch prices as current
Recording a workflow only after its claimed steps already occurred
